name: @wildflowerhealthio/lifting-core-js
description: Pure strength-training plans as FHIR R4 resources: a training plan definition (a PlanDefinition) of days and exercise definitions with their progression rule, an exercise ServiceRequest at one load, each workout performed as a Procedure and each set as an Observation part of it, the increment / hold / deload decision over completed workouts, the workout due next and the resources its submission writes, and the StrongLifts 5x5 template — each a schema narrowing the decoded fhir-r4 type, with a make and getters. No DOM, no platform imports.
